subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should ambient `room_event` turns keep strict effective `message_tool_only` delivery while using a session-stable prompt/tool/cache-facing mode, including the Responses cache-boundary split proposed in PR #102189?
rationale: The source fix shape changes prompt-visible authorization/tool and provider request construction without changing effective room-event delivery, which is a product and compatibility policy call rather than a narrow mechanical bugfix.

options.title: Refresh and review PR #102189
options.body: Resolve the conflict and continue with the candidate that covers room-event prompt mode, owner-only tool inventory stability, and Responses cache-boundary preservation.

options.title: Split the Responses work
options.body: Land only the room-event and tool-inventory stabilization here and keep broader OpenAI/Codex cache-boundary work under #95610.

options.title: Keep strict behavior only
options.body: Reject prompt-facing mode separation and instead document that room events intentionally change the prompt contract and may reduce cache reuse.

recommendation.title: Refresh and review PR #102189
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict and continue with the candidate that covers room-event prompt mode, owner-only tool inventory stability, and Responses cache-boundary preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main partial stabilization and touched the relevant docs/tests, making them the best available owner for accepting or reshaping the policy.
